# pbs_gotify_notification (Resource)

Manages a Gotify notification target.

Configure a Gotify server to receive push notifications from PBS about backup jobs,
verification tasks, and system events.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name identifier for the Gotify notification target.
- `server` (String) Gotify server URL (e.g., `https://gotify.example.com`).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Gotify application token for authentication.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) A comment describing this notification target.
- `disable` (Boolean) Disable this notification target. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `origin` (String) Origin of this configuration as reported by PBS (e.g., `user`, `builtin`).
